summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema ships preinstall dropper that runs an obfuscated Bun payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip, unzips it, chmods it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the sibling math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a ~727 KB one-line Bun CJS bundle using rotating string-array obfuscation (a WV8StW rotation function over a large constants array, single-character mangled identifiers, fragmented URL-shaped strings reassembled at runtime). The package is advertised as an ESLint plugin and lib/index.js is a small ESLint rule wrapper, so there is no legitimate reason to pull an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated 727 KB sibling script. Installing the package on default `npm install` therefore fetches an alternate runtime and executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine. package.json also credits author "ServiceTitan" and points at servicetitan/folder-lint, but the setup.mjs+math_init.js dropper stager is not part of that upstream project, consistent with impersonation of a trusted publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
